title: Foreshadow
subtitle: Authorize local workspace activity capture for agent context (editor, terminal, markdown).

capture.title: Capture
capture.description: Foreshadow only runs on local workspaces after you enable it. Remote and peer workspaces are unsupported.

task.title: Task recognition
task.description: Optional LLM-assisted task recognition over captured activity. Uses the BitFun model chain (fast → primary by default).

enabled.label: Enable Foreshadow capture
enabled.description: Authorize collecting local editor, terminal, and markdown activity into workspace context. Off by default.

remoteNotice.label: Remote workspace
remoteNotice.description: Foreshadow is unavailable for remote or peer workspaces. Open a local workspace to enable capture.

dataDir.label: Data directory
dataDir.noWorkspace: No active workspace. Data will be stored under {workspace}/.foreshadow/ when capture is ready.

mcpTool.label: Agent tool
mcpTool.description: Agents will read context via this tool name once the MCP path is wired (P6).

taskRecognize.label: Recognize tasks with LLM
taskRecognize.description: Allow TaskRecognizer to call a model periodically. Disable to keep capture-only mode.

taskModel.label: Task recognition model
taskModel.description: Model used for task recognition. Empty follows BitFun default (fast → primary).

status.ready: Capture runtime is ready for the active local workspace.
status.remoteUnsupported: Unavailable for remote or peer workspaces.
status.notAuthorized: Capture is disabled. Enable Foreshadow above.
status.internalError: Runtime error. Check logs for details.
